The REDMAGIC 11S Pro takes mobile gaming in a very different direction.
Liquid cooling. Active fan cooling. Shoulder triggers. Massive battery. Full-screen AMOLED display.
Instead of chasing camera specs or ultra-thin design, REDMAGIC built this device around one goal: sustained gaming performance.
Today we take a closer look at what makes the REDMAGIC 11S Pro different.
